summary.text: Kathleen Passidomo is a Republican member of the Florida Senate for District 28.

paragraphs.text: According to the Senate's biographical page, Passidomo was elected to the Senate in 2016 after serving in the Florida House of Representatives from 2010 to 2016, and was Senate President from 2022 to 2024.
Passidomo is an attorney, holds a B.A. from Trinity University (1975) and a J.D. from Stetson University College of Law (1978), was born in Jersey City, New Jersey, and moved to Florida in 1979.
